name: Slave Lapis
source:
"Poisonous thorns devoted to the Lord!!"

Having achieved perfect compatibility with Knight Gear, and obtaining the power of a Magical Girl that she has always dreamt of, Lapis has fulfilled her long-held wish. However, as a result, her female slave transformation has accelerated, and she now trembles with fear and even enters heat simply by catching a glimpse of the root of her past trauma, Kai Haibara. 

Despite this, Lapis, with her high pride, rallied herself and challenged Haibara bravely, only to suffer a humiliating defeat at his hands. Fascinated by Haibara's terrifying and ferocious nature, she became completely subservient to him and was reborn as a new utterly servile evil female slave, Slave Lapis.

Her once lively, proud and radiant smile has changed to a power-drunk, vulgar and wicked one towards all those who oppose her master and her... an arrogant expression reminiscent of her new master.

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/Rdw7yXL.jpeg]official character description[/url]]
